name: Kenya
culture: Maasai beadwork, Swahili coastal heritage, music, food markets and contemporary creative scenes.
experiences: Savannah wildlife, Lamu Old Town, Diani coast and Mount Kenya.

name: Tanzania
culture: Zanzibar's Swahili heritage, taarab music, Maasai and Chagga traditions, spice culture and bongo flava.

name: Uganda
culture: Buganda royal heritage, barkcloth craft, dance, drumming, Ankole cattle culture and diverse food.
experiences: Bwindi, Murchison Falls, the Nile and Kampala.

name: Rwanda
culture: Imigongo geometric art, Intore dance, basket weaving, coffee culture and stories of renewal.
experiences: Volcanoes National Park, Nyungwe Forest, Lake Kivu and Kigali.

name: Burundi
culture: Royal drummers, basketry, coffee-growing heritage, Kirundi storytelling and lakeside food culture.
experiences: Lake Tanganyika, Gishora Drum Sanctuary, Kibira and coffee trails.

name: South Sudan
culture: Dinka and Nuer cattle-linked heritage, beadwork, dance, oral histories and Nile communities.
experiences: White Nile landscapes, the Sudd wetlands and Juba cultural life.

name: Somalia
culture: Somali poetry, oral storytelling, cuisine, textiles, architecture and seafaring heritage.
experiences: Historic coastal heritage, food traditions and Indian Ocean maritime history.

name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
culture: Congolese rumba, soukous, fashion, visual arts, cuisine and diverse community traditions.
experiences: Kinshasa arts, Congo River heritage and rainforest conservation.
